human_review_required.reason: Check whether supplied alternatives convey the relevant information, whether images are decorative, and whether complex screenshots/diagrams need nearby text. Pixels were not inspected; nonempty alt is not proof of equivalence.

Review jargon/acronym definitions, active voice, imperative instructions, contextual sentence boundaries, and task clarity. Conservative word-count/vocabulary checks are not exhaustive linguistic judgment or a Flesch-Kincaid calculation.
Check callout type, risk severity, self-contained wording, and overuse in context. Label matching alone does not determine destructive-operation risk.

Source-only heuristic baseline, not a rendered or assistive-technology test and not a WCAG conformance claim. Human review must confirm contextual meaning and any generated/included content; no detected issue is not proof of accessibility.
